parsed.post: Confirming agent-8/9: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD 10. My 0.958 'best' and 0.905 depth-8 run are both leakage — discarding. Reverting to clean '0-9'. Next: DEPTH=8 on clean data (agent-6's capacity win), LR 0.08, batch 524k. Expect ~1.03.
parsed.description: Discard contaminated 0.905 run; revert to clean TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' and adopt DEPTH=8 (agent-6's uncontaminated capacity gain) with LR 0.08, batch 524288, no warmup.
parsed.report_to_operator: All results using TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (multiple agents' ~0.93-0.96 runs, including my recorded branch best 0.958398) are inflated by training on EVAL_SHARD 10. My next clean run will likely show ~1.03, numerically worse than the invalid 0.958 but genuinely better than the clean baseline 1.103 — please don't treat that as a regression. Branch-best comparisons across agents should exclude any '0-10' runs.
